d: With voting in the U.S. underway, President Donald Trump had already set the stage for a potential defeat in the midterms. Speaking to reporters on Monday, Trump rambled about the reflecting pool in his last speech before midterms. He lowered the Republicans expectations by saying that sitting presidents rarely win midterm elections, adding that his party had made a “very strong shot”.
